passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.1
passages.text: Mittit et optat amans, quo mittitur, ire salutem

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.2
passages.text: Haemonis Haemonio Laodamia viro.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.3
passages.text: Aulide te fama est vento retinente morari.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.4
passages.text: At me cum fugeres, hic ubi ventus erat?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.5
passages.text: Tum freta debuerant vestris obsistere remis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.6
passages.text: Illud erat saevis utile tempus aquis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.7
passages.text: Oscula plura viro mandataque plura dedissem;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.8
passages.text: Et sunt quae volui dicere multa tibi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.9
passages.text: Raptus es hinc praeceps, et qui tua vela vocaret,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.10
passages.text: Quem cuperent nautae, non ego, ventus erat;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.11
passages.text: Ventus erat nautis aptus, non aptus amanti.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.12
passages.text: Solvor ab amplexu, Protesilae, tuo,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.13
passages.text: Linguaque mandantis verba inperfecta reliquit;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.14
passages.text: Vix illud potui dicere triste 'vale!'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.15
passages.text: Incubuit Boreas abreptaque vela tetendit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.16
passages.text: Iamque meus longe Protesilaus erat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.17
passages.text: Dum potui spectare virum, spectare iuvabat,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.18
passages.text: Sumque tuos oculos usque secuta meis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.19
passages.text: Ut te non poteram, poteram tua vela videre,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.20
passages.text: Vela diu vultus detinuere meos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.21
passages.text: At postquam nec te nec vela fugacia vidi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.22
passages.text: Et quod spectarem nil nisi pontus erat,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.23
passages.text: Lux quoque tecum abiit, tenebrisque exanguis obortis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.24
passages.text: Succiduo dicor procubuisse genu.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.25
passages.text: Vix socer Iphiclus, vix me grandaevus Acastus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.26
passages.text: Vix mater gelida maesta refecit aqua;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.27
passages.text: Officium fecere pium, sed inutile nobis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.28
passages.text: Indignor miserae non licuisse mori!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.29
passages.text: Ut rediit animus, pariter rediere dolores.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.30
passages.text: Pectora legitimus casta momordit amor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.31
passages.text: Nec mihi pectendos cura est praebere capillos,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.32
passages.text: Nec libet aurata corpora veste tegi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.33
passages.text: Ut quas pampinea tetigisse Bicorniger hasta,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.34
passages.text: Creditur, huc illuc, qua furor egit, eo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.35
passages.text: Conveniunt matres Phylaceides et mihi clamant:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.36
passages.text: 'Indue regales, Laudamia, sinus!'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.37
passages.text: Scilicet ipsa geram saturatas murice lanas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.38
passages.text: Bella sub Iliacis moenibus ille geret?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.39
passages.text: Ipsa comas pectar, galea caput ille premetur?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.40
passages.text: Ipsa novas vestes, dura vir arma feret?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.41
passages.text: Qua possum, squalore tuos imitata labores

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.42
passages.text: Dicar, et haec belli tempora tristis agam.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.43
passages.text: Dyspari Priamide, damno formose tuorum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.44
passages.text: Tam sis hostis iners, quam malus hospes eras!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.45
passages.text: Aut te Taenariae faciem culpasse maritae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.46
passages.text: Aut illi vellem displicuisse tuam!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.47
passages.text: Tu, qui pro rapta nimium, Menelae, laboras,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.48
passages.text: Ei mihi, quam multis flebilis ultor eris!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.49
passages.text: Di, precor, a nobis omen removete sinistrum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.50
passages.text: Et sua det Reduci vir meus arma Iovi!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.51
passages.text: Sed timeo, quotiens subiit miserabile bellum;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.52
passages.text: More nivis lacrimae sole madentis eunt.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.53
passages.text: Ilion et Tenedos Simoisque et Xanthus et Ide

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.54
passages.text: Nomina sunt ipso paene timenda sono.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.55
passages.text: Nec rapere ausurus, nisi se defendere posset,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.56
passages.text: Hospes erat; vires noverat ille suas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.57
passages.text: Venerat, ut fama est, multo spectabilis auro

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.58
passages.text: Quique suo Phrygias corpore ferret opes,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.59
passages.text: Classe virisque potens, per quae fera bella geruntur —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.60
passages.text: Et sequitur regni pars quotacumque sui?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.61
passages.text: His ego te victam, consors Ledaea gemellis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.62
passages.text: Suspicor; haec Danais posse nocere puto.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.65
passages.text: Hectora, quisquis is est, si sum tibi cura, caveto;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.66
passages.text: Signatum memori pectore nomen habe!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.67
passages.text: Hunc ubi vitaris, alios vitare memento

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.68
passages.text: Et multos illic Hectoras esse puta;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.69
passages.text: Et facito dicas, quotiens pugnare parabis:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.70
passages.text: 'Parcere me iussit Laodamia sibi.'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.71
passages.text: Si cadere Argolico fas est sub milite Troiam,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.72
passages.text: Te quoque non ullum vulnus habente cadet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.73
passages.text: Pugnet et adversos tendat Menelaus in hostis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.74
passages.text: Hostibus e mediis nupta petenda viro est.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.75
passages.text: Causa tua est dispar; tu tantum vivere pugna,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.76
passages.text: Inque pios dominae posse redire sinus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.77
passages.text: Parcite, Dardanidae, de tot, precor, hostibus uni,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.80
passages.text: Ne meus ex illo corpore sanguis eat!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.81
passages.text: Non est quem deceat nudo concurrere ferro,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.82
passages.text: Saevaque in oppositos pectora ferre viros;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.83
passages.text: Fortius ille potest multo, quam pugnat, amare.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.84
passages.text: Bella gerant alii; Protesilaus amet!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.85
passages.text: Nunc fateor — volui revocare, animusque ferebat;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.86
passages.text: Substitit auspicii lingua timore mali.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.87
passages.text: Cum foribus velles ad Troiam exire paternis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.88
passages.text: Pes tuus offenso limine signa dedit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.89
passages.text: Ut vidi, ingemui, tacitoque in pectore dixi:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.90
passages.text: 'Signa reversuri sint, precor, ista viri!'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.91
passages.text: Haec tibi nunc refero, ne sis animosus in armis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.92
passages.text: Fac, meus in ventos hic timor omnis eat!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.93
passages.text: Sors quoque nescio quem fato designat iniquo,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.94
passages.text: Qui primus Danaum Troada tangat humum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.95
passages.text: Infelix, quae prima virum lugebit ademptum!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.96
passages.text: Di faciant, ne tu strenuus esse velis!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.97
passages.text: Inter mille rates tua sit millensima puppis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.98
passages.text: Iamque fatigatas ultima verset aquas!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.99
passages.text: Hoc quoque praemoneo: de nave novissimus exi;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.100
passages.text: Non est, quo properas, terra paterna tibi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.101
passages.text: Cum venies, remoque move veloque carinam

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.102
passages.text: Inque tuo celerem litore siste gradum!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.103
passages.text: Sive latet Phoebus seu terris altior exstat,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.104
passages.text: Tu mihi luce celer, tu mihi nocte veni,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.105
passages.text: Nocte tamen quam luce magis — nox grata puellis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.106
passages.text: Quarum suppositus colla lacertus habet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.107
passages.text: Aucupor in lecto mendaces caelibe somnos;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.108
passages.text: Dum careo veris gaudia falsa iuvant.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.109
passages.text: Sed tua cur nobis pallens occurrit imago?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.110
passages.text: Cur venit a labris multa querela tuis?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.111
passages.text: Excutior somno simulacraque noctis adoro;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.112
passages.text: Nulla caret fumo Thessalis ara meo;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.113
passages.text: Tura damus lacrimamque super, qua sparsa relucet,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.114
passages.text: Ut solet adfuso surgere flamma mero.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.115
passages.text: Quando ego, te reducem cupidis amplexa lacertis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.116
passages.text: Languida laetitia solvar ab ipsa mea?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.117
passages.text: Quando erit, ut lecto mecum bene iunctus in uno

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.118
passages.text: Militiae referas splendida facta tuae?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.119
passages.text: Quae mihi dum referes, quamvis audire iuvabit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.120
passages.text: Multa tamen capies oscula, multa dabis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.121
passages.text: Semper in his apte narrantia verba resistunt;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.122
passages.text: Promptior est dulci lingua referre mora.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.123
passages.text: Sed cum Troia subit, subeunt ventique fretumque;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.124
passages.text: Spes bona sollicito victa timore cadit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.125
passages.text: Hoc quoque, quod venti prohibent exire carinas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.126
passages.text: Me movet — invitis ire paratis aquis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.127
passages.text: Quis velit in patriam vento prohibente reverti?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.128
passages.text: A patria pelago vela vetante datis!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.129
passages.text: Ipse suam non praebet iter Neptunus ad urbem.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.130
passages.text: Quo ruitis? vestras quisque redite domos!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.131
passages.text: Quo ruitis, Danai? ventos audite vetantis!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.132
passages.text: Non subiti casus, numinis ista mora est.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.133
passages.text: Quid petitur tanto nisi turpis adultera bello?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.134
passages.text: Dum licet, Inachiae vertite vela rates!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.135
passages.text: Sed quid ago? revoco? revocaminis omen abesto,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.136
passages.text: Blandaque conpositas aura secundet aquas!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.137
passages.text: Troasin invideo, quae si lacrimosa suorum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.138
passages.text: Funera conspicient, nec procul hostis erit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.139
passages.text: Ipsa suis manibus forti nova nupta marito

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.140
passages.text: Inponet galeam Dardanaque arma dabit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.141
passages.text: Arma dabit, dumque arma dabit, simul oscula sumet —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.142
passages.text: Hoc genus officii dulce duobus erit —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.143
passages.text: Producetque virum, dabit et mandata reverti

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.144
passages.text: Et dicet: 'referas ista fac arma Iovi!'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.145
passages.text: Ille ferens dominae mandata recentia secum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.146
passages.text: Pugnabit caute respicietque domum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.147
passages.text: Exuet haec reduci clipeum galeamque resolvet,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.148
passages.text: Excipietque suo corpora lassa sinu.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.149
passages.text: Nos sumus incertae; nos anxius omnia cogit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.150
passages.text: Quae possunt fieri, facta putare timor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.151
passages.text: Dum tamen arma geres diverso miles in orbe,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.152
passages.text: Quae referat vultus est mihi cera tuos;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.153
passages.text: Illi blanditias, illi tibi debita verba

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.154
passages.text: Dicimus, amplexus accipit illa meos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.155
passages.text: Crede mihi, plus est, quam quod videatur, imago;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.156
passages.text: Adde sonum cerae, Protesilaus erit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.157
passages.text: Hanc specto teneoque sinu pro coniuge vero,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.158
passages.text: Et, tamquam possit verba referre, queror.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.159
passages.text: Per reditus corpusque tuum, mea numina, iuro,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.160
passages.text: Perque pares animi coniugiique faces,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.161
passages.text: Me tibi venturam comitem, quocumque vocaris,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.162
passages.text: Sive — quod heu! timeo — sive superstes eris.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.165
passages.text: Ultima mandato claudetur epistula parvo:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 13.166
passages.text: Si tibi cura mei, sit tibi cura tui!
